previous_statement: By the registered external GT-arkowitz-brown-2004-thm-1.2: if f:X->X is a map of a finite polyhedron with a finite set of fixed points, each of which lies in a maximal simplex of X, then its Lefschetz number L(f) is the sum of the indices of all the fixed points of f.
new_statement: By the registered external GT-arkowitz-brown-2004-thm-1.2 (verbatim Theorem 1.2, Lefschetz-Hopf): If f : X → X is a map of a finite polyhedron with a finite set of fixed points, each of which lies in a maximal simplex of X, then L( f ) is the sum of the indices of all the fixed points of f.
